scope: 14 curated public source leads; not exhaustive; no video transcription

sources.title: Riot — Character Art
sources.evidence: official article read; linked video not transcribed
sources.summary: Character production translates 2D design into a readable 3D silhouette. Proportions, likeness, anatomy and texture painting must work at the small size seen in gameplay. Use silhouette and value grouping reviews before adding surface detail.

sources.title: Riot — So You Wanna Make Games: Character Art
sources.evidence: official Riot link verified; video fetch throttled; no transcript obtained
sources.summary: Video lead for a future detailed breakdown. Workflow guidance is sourced from the accompanying official Riot article, not an unobserved transcript.
headings: So You Wanna Make Games?? | Episode 3: Character Art - YouTube

sources.title: Yasuo official champion reference
sources.summary: Primary visual reference for the requested swordsman. Analyze ponytail silhouette, asymmetrical shoulder mass, curved sword and cloth motion. Wind Ronin is a separate original concept and procedural technical prototype, not an official Riot asset.

sources.title: Retopology
sources.summary: Create deformation-oriented edge flow for shoulder, elbow, knee, face and hands. Decimation reduces polygon count but is not a substitute for authored deformation topology. Preserve the source sculpt and compare silhouette before and after reduction.

sources.title: Cycles Render Baking
sources.summary: Bake high-poly detail into textures after UVs are prepared. Select the intended source and target, set ray distance or cage deliberately, test seams and bake misses. Validate normals in the target engine. The demo only creates procedural microdetail and does not claim a high-poly bake.

sources.title: glTF 2.0 import/export
sources.summary: Use supported image texture and Principled material channels for portable glTF PBR. Test skinning and exported animation clips by reopening the GLB. glTF does not make every arbitrary Blender shader portable.

sources.title: Decimate modifier — Korean manual
sources.evidence: official translated manual; direct HTTP collection
sources.summary: LOD candidates can use polygon reduction. Compare rendered silhouette, UV seams and skin deformation at real screen sizes. A target ratio alone is not an art or performance acceptance test.

sources.title: 게임 테크놀로지 — instant Meshe 프로그램
sources.evidence: video URL located through Korean creator article; transcript not obtained
sources.summary: Korean-language tutorial discovery lead for Instant Meshes. Do not infer full character rigging quality from automated retopology. Video content remains unreviewed beyond its public identification.
headings: 게임 테크놀로지 - instant Meshe 프로그램 - YouTube

sources.title: Instant Meshes — authors repository
sources.summary: Optional field-aligned remeshing research tool. Evaluate topology under joint deformation before adopting it for animated characters. This dependency is not installed or required by the current Blender worker.
headings: GitHub - wjakob/instant-meshes: Interactive field-aligned mesh generator · GitHub

sources.title: Armature skinning — Japanese manual
sources.evidence: official translated manual; direct HTTP collection
sources.summary: Armature parenting and automatic weights provide a starting point. Test deform groups and normalize weights; inspect shoulder, elbow, wrist, knee and garment intersections instead of accepting automatic weights without review.
headings: Armature Deform Parent - Blender 4.5 LTS Manual

sources.title: Weight Paint editing — Chinese manual
sources.evidence: official translated manual; direct HTTP collection
sources.summary: Weight editing includes normalizing weights, cleaning small influences and limiting influence count. The project profile proposes at most four deforming influences per vertex, followed by motion and deformation review.
headings: 编辑权重绘制 - Blender 4.5 LTS Manual

sources.title: Hamburn彬仔 — 角色绑定与权重绘制技巧
sources.evidence: original creator public description and chapter listing read; video not transcribed
sources.summary: Original Chinese tutorial lead on character rigging and weight painting. Its public series listing includes head/body creation and later blinking/wind effects. Retain this as a discovery source; paid ARP functionality is not a runtime dependency.

sources.title: Creative Assembly — Character artist pipeline
sources.evidence: search-indexed first-party post excerpt; direct page has no readable body
sources.summary: The studio lists high/low polygon modeling, baking, texturing, topology and workflow optimization as character-art skills. This is a broad competency checklist, not measured technical budgets or a full tutorial.
